target_fidelity.note: It is a positive active imperative with no modal.

naturalness.note: The dark-room context naturally supports the instruction.

determinacy.note: The cue and context determine the accepted wording.

non_target_language_simplicity.note: All vocabulary is common and transparent.

no_answer_leakage.note: The prompt gives a cue, not the completed sentence.

no_extraneous_grammar.note: Only a simple imperative is needed.
